channel.title: Zethian
channel.description: Permission models, least privilege, and security boundaries for coding agents.

item.title: The Case for Narrow Exceptions
item.description: Claude Code resolves permission rules in a fixed order, so a broad deny with a narrow exception cannot be expressed. permcheck runs as a PreToolUse hook and lets a narrower allow or ask override a matching deny, but only when the deny already covers every call the exception matches. Includes the shell analysis it performs and the limits of what a permission hook can enforce.
